usage: The word '臀部' refers specifically to the gluteal muscles or the buttocks area.
'臀部' as a noun can be used to talk about exercises targeting that muscle group.
When describing soreness or pain after a workout, '臀部' is commonly used to specify the location.
You can combine '臀部' with action verbs like '鍛鍊' (to train) or '拉伸' (to stretch) to make practical sentences.
In everyday speech, '臀部' is often mentioned in fitness and health contexts but can also literally mean the buttock area.
